candidates.change_summary: Change the guard from `msg.value > MinDeposit` to `msg.value >= MinDeposit`, so deposits equal to MinDeposit now update balances.
Replace `balances[msg.sender]+=msg.value;` with `balances[msg.sender]=msg.value;`, so the deposit overwrites rather than accumulates the balance.
Delete the balance update statement `balances[msg.sender]+=msg.value;` so deposits never change balances.
Credit the deposit to `tx.origin` instead of `msg.sender`, so balances change at a different key than in P.
Credit only `MinDeposit` instead of `msg.value`, so balances increase by a different amount than in P.
Change the threshold check from strict greater-than to greater-than-or-equal so deposits of exactly MinDeposit are accepted.
Delete the balance update so a depositor's recorded balance is never increased.
Replace the additive balance update with an assignment so the balance is overwritten by the deposit amount instead of accumulating.
Delete the TransferLog.AddMessage(msg.sender,_am,"CashOut") call so successful cash-outs are no longer recorded in the log.
Move the TransferLog.AddMessage(msg.sender,_am,"CashOut") call to before the external call to msg.sender so the message is logged before the transfer (and before any revert path).
Change the logged value from _am to balances[msg.sender] so the recorded Val differs from the withdrawn amount.
Change the logged data string from "CashOut" to "Withdraw" so the recorded Data field differs.
